title: decode_record_header returns PayloadTooLarge before any allocation on hostile input
claim: For any arbitrary bytes h and any max > 0, if h.payload_len > max, decode_record_header returns Err(PayloadTooLarge) before any Vec allocation
leak_prevention: Kani harness must use kani::any() for header bytes, not hardcoded dummy data. Prove: decode_record_header(b, magic, max) returns Err(PayloadTooLarge) when payload_len > max, and no branch before line 48 creates a Vec.

title: decode_record_header never panics on any input length
claim: decode_record_header is total on &[u8]; it returns Err for all inputs, never panics
leak_prevention: Kani harness uses kani::any::<[u8; 60]>() and kani::any::<[u8; 61]>() and kani::any::<[u8; 59]>() to cover exactly-60, longer, and shorter inputs. Also kani::any::<u32>() for magic and max.

title: decode_record_payload never slices beyond budget
claim: After decode_record_header returns Ok, bytes[60..60+payload_len] is bounded by max_payload_len and fits in bytes.len()
leak_prevention: Kani harness uses kani::any() for all header fields including payload_len, and kani::any::<u32>() for max_payload_len. Prove that bytes.get(60..60+payload_len) returns Some only when payload_len ≤ max.

title: checked_add prevents overflow in payload_end
claim: payload_end = 60usize.checked_add(payload_len_usize) returns None on overflow, preventing wraparound
leak_prevention: Kani harness generates arbitrary u32 payload_len. Prove checked_add returns None when 60 + payload_len overflows usize.

title: decode_record_header enforces magic family constraint
claim: decode_record_header returns BadMagic before HeaderChecksumMismatch, PayloadTooLarge, or any other error when magic mismatches
leak_prevention: Kani harness uses kani::any() for magic, not hardcoded magic. Prove BadMagic is returned for any non-matching magic before other errors.

title: decode_record_header rejects unknown record_kind
claim: decode_record_header returns UnknownRecordKind before HeaderChecksumMismatch when record_kind is invalid
leak_prevention: Kani harness generates arbitrary u16 for record_kind. Prove UnknownRecordKind is returned for unknown kinds.

title: decode_record_header rejects payload_len > max_payload_len
claim: Budget check at line 48 returns PayloadTooLarge before any branch that could allocate memory
leak_prevention: Kani harness generates arbitrary u32 payload_len and u32 max_payload_len where len > max. Prove Err(PayloadTooLarge) is returned before any Vec creation.

title: decode_record_header header length must equal 60
claim: decode_record_header returns HeaderLengthMismatch when header_len ≠ 60
leak_prevention: Kani harness generates arbitrary u32 for header_len via kani::any(). Prove HeaderLengthMismatch for any value ≠ 60.

title: decode_record_header rejects wrong schema version
claim: decode_record_header returns UnsupportedSchemaVersion for version > 1 and MigrationRequired for version < 1
leak_prevention: Kani harness generates arbitrary u16 for schema_version. Prove correct error for version > 1 and version < 1.

title: decode_record_header rejects header CRC mismatch
claim: decode_record_header returns HeaderChecksumMismatch when CRC32C of first 56 bytes does not match header_checksum field
leak_prevention: Kani harness generates arbitrary u32 for header_checksum. Prove HeaderChecksumMismatch when CRC mismatches.

title: decode_record_payload rejects corrupt payload digest
claim: decode_record_payload returns PayloadDigestMismatch when blake3(payload) ≠ header.payload_digest, even if payload_len ≤ max
leak_prevention: Kani harness generates arbitrary payload bytes that pass budget check but have wrong digest. Prove PayloadDigestMismatch is returned.

title: decode_optional performs no allocation before decode_record_header
claim: decode_optional calls keyspace.get() which returns borrowed &[u8], then calls decode_record which budgets before allocation
leak_prevention: Kani harness traces decode_optional call path. Prove keyspace.get returns borrowed bytes and decode_record_header runs before any postcard allocation.

title: decode_journal_event enforces semantic validity after successful decode
claim: decode_journal_event returns InvalidEvent when JournalEvent::is_valid() is false, even if postcard deserialization succeeded
leak_prevention: Kani harness generates arbitrary JournalEvent bytes that deserialize but have run_id=0, seq=u64::MAX, or attempt=0. Prove InvalidEvent is returned.

title: snapshot read respects MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES budget
claim: FjallJournal::snapshot enforces MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES budget via decode_optional
leak_prevention: Kani harness calls snapshot() with arbitrary run/seq. Prove payload_len ≤ MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES before postcard deserializes RunSnapshot.

title: blob read respects MAX_BLOB_BYTES budget
claim: FjallJournal::blob enforces MAX_BLOB_BYTES budget via decode_optional
leak_prevention: Kani harness calls blob() with arbitrary digest. Prove payload_len ≤ MAX_BLOB_BYTES before postcard deserializes BlobRecord.

title: decode_record_header is total function (no panic on empty input)
claim: decode_record_header returns Err(UnexpectedEof) for input.len() < 60, not panic
leak_prevention: Verus spec fn models decode_record_header with explicit slice bounds checking. Proves get(..60) returns None → UnexpectedEof.

title: payload_len type invariant: payload_len is validated u32 after budget check
claim: After decode_record_header returns Ok, payload_len is a u32 that satisfies payload_len ≤ max_payload_len
leak_prevention: Verus spec fn ensures payload_len invariant holds in postcondition. max_payload_len is a parameter.

title: TLA+ model: keyspace prefix distinctness prevents cross-keyspace reads
claim: All 9 keyspace prefixes are pairwise distinct; a key with prefix P can only exist in keyspace with prefix P
leak_prevention: TLA+ spec defines 9 keyspaces with distinct first-byte prefixes. Invariant: prefix distinctness holds for all keyspaces.

title: TLA+ model: budget-before-decode workflow invariant
claim: For all record reads: payload_len > max → decode returns PayloadTooLarge, and no payload bytes are read
leak_prevention: TLA+ spec models decode_record_header with explicit payload_len > max condition. Invariant: if payload_len > max, error = PayloadTooLarge and payload not accessed.

title: Kani: fuzz target decode_record never panics on arbitrary bytes
claim: cargo kani --fuzz decode_record proves no panic on any arbitrary bytes input
leak_prevention: Fuzz target uses arbitrary bytes from fuzzer. Kani harness replaces fuzzer input with kani::any() for exhaustiveness.
